summary: Phase 7C-B1 tested end to end. Backend live API: 28/28 pass (13 new in test_ai_calling_phase7cb1_api.py plus the 15 tests from the 7C-A API regression file). Scratch suite: 292 passed, 30 skipped, no AutoReconnect flake this run. Booking-link consent renewal: unknown token, malformed digits, 3-digit input and empty body all return 400 with the same generic message and no-store headers (only 4 invalid attempts sent). Retention: policy is 90 days, proposed, deletion off; Bolna note present; can_manage true. Preview is a dry run with deleted 0; the 1 real call is not_yet_due at 90 days and eligible at days=1. The ai_calls documents were byte-identical before and after preview and execute. Execute returns 423, days:10 returns 400, a hold was added and released, CSRF and unauthenticated requests are refused. worker-status: running/enabled false, provider mock, banner correct, readiness.ready false, 401 when unauthenticated. Switches unchanged (Test ON, Live OFF, Emergency Stop ON); authorize still 423; plan/mock-tick/clear still work. Frontend: dashboard banner and all 9 worker cells render. The Live Prep tab shows LiveWorkerStatus above readiness; Synthetic and Real tabs work. Settings retention panel works: warning, days, storage map, preview counts and rows, and days=1 changes the result. ConsentRenewBox was checked with route mocking: input is digits only (max 4), submit stays disabled until 4 digits, the error and success paths show correctly, the link is /ai-consent#t=… with rel noopener, and the box is hidden when already_scheduled is false. No console errors. No horizontal overflow at 390.

minor.issue: Once a registration is locked, a VALID schedule_token returns 429 'Too many attempts' while an unknown token returns 400 generic. The different response reveals that a token is valid. The locked-path 429 is also raised directly, not via _fail, so it does not add to the IP failure counter. Low risk because the attacker already needs the booking token.
Version = current+1 with no unique index on ai_retention_policies.version. Concurrent proposals could create duplicate versions. Minor.
Iterates all ai_calls with no projection or pagination and loads full transcripts into memory. Fine now (1 call) but will not scale.

issues: The preview table scrolls sideways inside its container. The Status and Fields columns start off-screen, and a tall empty area shows because the narrow Fields column wraps. Consider a stacked card layout on mobile.
The yellow TEST MODE banner overlaps the hamburger button.
The date field uses the browser's native date picker.
The 'Run retention preview' button has no loading or disabled state. data-testid 'retention-row-status' is repeated on every row (not unique).

Optional: mobile-friendly retention preview rows and a busy state on the preview button
